messages:
Alex (oncall): passing the evening shift to @Priya. quick summary: saw a rise in eviction-related throttles on us-west-2 GPU pool starting ~18:05 PST, intermittent customer 5xxs reported, autoscaler flapping suspected. i'm primary until 23:00, priya you're secondary.
Priya (secondary): ack. i'm on standby 23:00-03:00. hitting pager on call?
Alex (oncall): yes, two pagers earlier. incident-bot posted alerts + runbook link. minimal customer impact so far — a handful of requests hit fallback model (cpu) and increased latency.
incident-bot: [ALERT] evictions.rate > 0.5% over 5m on pool=gpu-us-west-2, impacted service=routing, severity=page (pager sent to @oncall). docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eviction-throttle
Rui (SRE): i'm looking at the autoscaler activity. saw repeated scale-down/scale-up in the same host group which correlates with the eviction spikes. looks like a mis-tuned cooldown.
Alex (oncall): Rui, can you paste the autoscaler window and last scale events?
Rui (SRE): gist of events:
```
2026-03-14T17:58:30Z scale-down instancegroup-5 -> -3
2026-03-14T18:01:12Z scale-up instancegroup-5 -> +4
2026-03-14T18:04:50Z scale-down instancegroup-5 -> -2
2026-03-14T18:09:05Z scale-up instancegroup-5 -> +5
```
Cooldown looks set to 60s; that's too short for our warmup on these GPUs.
Maya (CSE): flagged by Support: a handful of customers in enterprise-us reported retries and slow responses between 18:06-18:20. none have severe data loss, but they saw degraded UX. customer tickets: #6210, #6212.
Alex (oncall): customer impact assessment: partial latency degradation for ~0.2% of requests in us-west-2. no broad outage. recommended severity: P2.
Priya (secondary): ok. immediate mitigation ideas?
Rui (SRE): short-term: increase autoscaler cooldown to 300s and add a minimum warm pool of 2 nodes to instancegroup-5. long-term: smoother scaling policy and health probe change to avoid evict-triggered scale decisions.
Alex (oncall): Praising quick win: i'll apply the cooldown change now in staging then prod if green. command i'll run: `kubectl apply -f autoscaler/cooldown-us-west-2.yaml` then monitor.
Priya (secondary): i'll watch observability dashboards (evictions, p95, scale events) and keep the pager open.
incident-bot: Deployment: autoscaler tweak attempted by Alex at 18:24 PST — status=rolling. logs: https://console.redwood.internal/deploys/4332
Rui (SRE): after applying cooldown=300s and minNodes=2, we saw fewer rapid scale cycles. evictions dropped to 0.05% within ~6m. p95 latency decreased but still slightly above baseline: ~120ms over baseline.
Maya (CSE): notified affected customers with a brief note. asked them to escalate if they see repeated failures.
Alex (oncall): notes for next shift:
- root cause hypothesis: autoscaler cooldown too short for GPU warmup; scale flapping caused fragile packing -> eviction spikes.
- remediation performed: cooldown increased to 300s, min warm nodes set to 2 for instancegroup-5, temporary routing preference set to us-east-1 for heavy tenants if latency > 500ms.
- status: stable for 30m, evictions trending down. watchlist: evictions.rate, scale events, fallback_count, high latency for enterprise-us.
- follow-ups (owners): Rui to create a ticket for autoscaler policy changes and testing (TG: autoscaler-team). Alex to run a postmortem doc with timeline and customer impact (TG: oncall). Priya to cover overnight and escalate if any regressions.
Priya (secondary): noted. coverage gap: our oncall overlap between 02:00-03:00 will be light — i'm covering but i might be slow if I'm in meetings. request a backup contact from infra guild between 02:00-04:00.
Alex (oncall): ok assigning backup: Rui will be backup for 02:00-04:00. Rui, confirm?
Rui (SRE): i can be backup 02:00-04:00. will set a short alert rule to page me if evictions spike above 0.4% during that window.
Maya (CSE): i'll follow up with customers if any of them report reoccurrence overnight.
Alex (oncall): final checklist before handoff:
- slack channel: pinned runbook updated (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eviction-throttle) :white_check_mark:
- monitoring alerts: cooldown changes reflected, new alert staging -> prod :white_check_mark:
- customer comms: sent :white_check_mark:
- postmortem: draft due tomorrow EOD by Alex.
Priya (secondary): taking the handoff now. thanks all, i'll ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread closed for passback at 18:58 PST (automated handoff summary attached).
